title: Ship traffic and military activity identified as emerging sources of lead in remote island air
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3132-3147
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00295H, Paper
Iravati Ray, Jariya Kayee, Xianfeng Wang, Reshmi Das
Atmospheric particulate matter (PM) pollution in remote, tropical island environments remains underexplored, a significant knowledge gap compared to extensive studies in polar and high-altitude regions (e.g., Arctic, Antarctic, and Tibetan Plateau).
